purpose.statement: Convert an exact approved WorkBreakdownBaseline into a complete candidate dependency graph that becomes authoritative only after deterministic and semantic Gate verification.

businessObjectives.statement: Prevent invalid, cyclic, incomplete, or impossible dependency plans from reaching assignment and execution.
Replace dependency-analysis capabilities without changing canonical semantics or generic Core.
Provide authoritative ordering sufficient for downstream systems to identify safely runnable work.

successMetrics.name: Generic Core product branches
successMetrics.measure: WorkDependencyAnalysis, Spec Kit, or OpenSpec identifier branches in generic Core.
successMetrics.measurementMethod: Run static special-case scans and adapter-replacement conformance tests.

successMetrics.name: Unsafe runnable frontier
successMetrics.measure: Work items exposed as runnable while an authoritative predecessor remains incomplete.
successMetrics.measurementMethod: Derive runnable frontiers from approved DAG fixtures and predecessor completion state.

successMetrics.name: Invalid dependency progression
successMetrics.measure: Invalid endpoint, duplicate or self edge, cycle, unresolved missing dependency, or impossible ordering cases reaching an approved baseline.
successMetrics.measurementMethod: Run positive and negative WorkDependency Gate fixtures and inspect exact promotion receipts.

stakeholders.name: Dependency adapter author
stakeholders.role: Map a bounded native capability to the canonical contract.

stakeholders.name: Downstream execution host
stakeholders.role: Use the approved DAG when selecting runnable work.
interests: No work starts before predecessors complete.

stakeholders.name: DevRelay maintainer
stakeholders.role: Own the canonical module, Gate, and trusted validation boundary.

stakeholders.name: Workflow author
stakeholders.role: Configure dependency analysis and review proposed ordering.

users.name: Dependency-planning workflow author
users.description: A maintainer or host operator who runs and reviews dependency analysis before assignment.
needs: Approve only a valid and reviewed DAG.

capabilities.name: Work dependency analysis
capabilities.description: Analyze an approved work breakdown and propose directed dependencies and dispositions.

capabilities.name: Dependency Gate verification
capabilities.description: Validate graph mechanics and semantic policy before authoritative promotion.

userJourneys.name: Analyze and approve work dependencies
userJourneys.outcome: An authoritative dependency baseline is approved or progression stops with findings.

steps.action: Invoke the configured bounded dependency analyzer.
steps.expectedOutcome: A checkpointed canonical candidate or clarification is produced.

steps.action: Run graph and semantic policy checks.
steps.expectedOutcome: Invalid references, cycles, missing dependencies, and impossible ordering block progression.

steps.action: Approve the exact candidate at WorkDependency Gate.
steps.expectedOutcome: The candidate becomes the authoritative baseline with evidence.

userStories.need: Analyze every work item and dependency hint against exact upstream context.
userStories.benefit: I receive a complete, traceable dependency proposal.

userStories.need: Provide authoritative predecessors without scheduling or executing work.
userStories.benefit: A later scheduler can derive current safe parallel opportunities.

userStories.need: Replace the analyzer through exact host configuration.
userStories.benefit: The workflow can adopt better tools without changing Core or contracts.

userStories.need: Reject invalid or semantically incomplete dependency candidates.
userStories.benefit: Downstream work cannot inherit known-invalid ordering.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: WorkDependency Gate rejects self-dependencies and every directed cycle with a deterministic cycle witness.
acceptanceCriteria.verification: Exercise self-loop, two-node, nested, and disjoint cycles across replays.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Exact inputs, adapter identity, configuration, grants, policy, and checkpoint state produce the same Core-owned route, validation, graph digest, diagnostics, and replay without reinvocation.
acceptanceCriteria.verification: Execute repeated and replayed runs and compare outputs and call counts.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: A candidate is bound to one exact WorkBreakdownBaseline and contains every baseline work-item ID exactly once with no additional IDs.
acceptanceCriteria.verification: Run exact-set fixtures for omitted, duplicated, and foreign IDs.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Every dependency hint receives exactly one evidence-backed disposition.
acceptanceCriteria.verification: Exercise accepted, rejected, replaced, duplicated, and omitted dispositions.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: All direct baselines, repository context, and policy inputs are immutable and coherence-checked against WorkBreakdown before adapter entry.
acceptanceCriteria.verification: Mutate each version, digest, repository revision, tree digest, or lineage pointer and verify pre-adapter drift with zero adapter calls.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: WorkDependency Gate rejects unresolved blocking missing-dependency findings under the exact DependencyPolicy and verification evidence.
acceptanceCriteria.verification: Use independent semantic-check fixtures with omitted prerequisites and verify no promotion until resolved or explicitly approved by policy.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: WorkDependencyAnalysis does not assign, estimate, schedule, execute, modify code, record completion, or collect implementation evidence.
acceptanceCriteria.verification: Inspect schemas, capabilities, effects, fixtures, and graph assertions for prohibited fields and effects.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: WorkDependency Gate rejects invalid endpoints, duplicate edges, contradictory evidence, and policy-forbidden ordering.
acceptanceCriteria.verification: Run one negative fixture per rejection and verify stable codes and no commit payload.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: The approved artifact provides predecessor relationships sufficient for a later scheduler to derive runnable work without mutable assignment or execution state.
acceptanceCriteria.verification: Derive frontiers for multiple completion states while the dependency artifact remains unchanged.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: A bounded analyzer may propose dependencies, dispositions, findings, and native evidence but cannot route, promote, access TraceabilityGraph, or author graph operations.
acceptanceCriteria.verification: Swap adapters and attempt prohibited behavior while scanning generic Core.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: A trusted contributor derives only forward candidate dependency relationships; Core checkpoint-merges them and Gate approval activates separate authoritative scope without inverse or completion edges.
acceptanceCriteria.verification: Attempt adapter graph operations, then verify projection, merge proof, replay, retirement, and approved authority.

nonFunctionalRequirements.statement: Routing, mechanical validation, canonical ordering, replay, and Gate commit preparation must be deterministic for exact inputs.
nonFunctionalRequirements.measure: Canonical output, diagnostic, route, and replay digest equality.
nonFunctionalRequirements.target: 100 percent equality for deterministic Core-owned behavior.

constraints.statement: WorkDependencyAnalysis is analysis and approval, not assignment, scheduling, or execution.
constraints.rationale: Separate lifecycle authority prevents planned ordering from becoming an execution claim.

constraints.statement: Canonical contracts and Core cannot depend on a model, Spec Kit, OpenSpec, or another analyzer product.
Traceability stores forward dependency assertions only and derives reverse traversal at query time.
constraints.rationale: One direction avoids duplicated inconsistent facts.

scope.statement: Bounded replaceable analysis manifests and conformance fixtures.
Provider-neutral dependency analysis bound to exact WorkBreakdown and upstream context.
Dependency state, policy, hint-disposition, edge, finding, candidate, baseline, clarification, diagnostic, and Gate evidence artifacts.
A separate Gate for graph mechanics, semantic policy, approval, and exact promotion.
A trusted contributor and candidate-to-approved authority transition.

nonGoals.statement: Choose a specialist, model, agent, or human.
Introduce a distributed scheduler, agent framework, provider wrapper, or general control plane.
nonGoals.rationale: This release is an incremental module slice.

nonGoals.statement: Execute, implement, test, or verify a work item.
Persist schedules, estimates, capacity, or runtime execution waves.
nonGoals.rationale: Scheduling depends on changing runtime state.

terminology.definition: A directed acyclic graph where each forward edge says one predecessor must complete before one successor may start.
The evidence-backed treatment of one non-authoritative WorkBreakdown dependency hint.
A dependency forbidden by exact domain, architecture, contract, repository, or policy evidence even when acyclic.
Work items whose authoritative predecessors are complete under current runtime state.

currentStatus.summary: WorkBreakdown 0.1.0 is committed. WorkDependencyAnalysis RequirementsGathering is paused on five blocking decisions before baseline promotion or ArchitectureDesign.

assumptions.statement: The analyzer receives exact requirements, architecture, contract, repository, overview, WorkBreakdown, and policy context.
One full-snapshot analyze-dependencies operation is preferable to establish and change operations.
The module stores only the DAG while a downstream scheduler derives runnable frontiers.
V1 defines bounded Spec Kit analyze and custom OpenSpec dependency-artifact contracts without claiming live interoperability.
Adapters propose dependencies, Core validates mechanics, and the Gate independently verifies semantics and promotes.

dependencies: Approved ProjectOverview, requirements, architecture, contract-disposition, and repository contracts.
Approved WorkBreakdown 0.1.0 and exact WorkBreakdownBaseline contract.
Generic registry, effect checkpoint, Gate replay, and TraceabilityGraph boundaries.
Owner responses to the five blocking requirements questions.
risks: Ambiguous edge direction could duplicate inverse facts.
Analyzer silence could be mistaken for proof that no dependency is missing.
Hidden adapter-selected context could violate deterministic invocation contracts.
Reused task adapters could blur decomposition and dependency authority.
Stored execution waves could couple static dependencies to changing runtime state.
deliverables: Approved WorkDependencyAnalysis requirements and ProjectOverview baseline.
Bounded manifests, fixtures, dogfood evidence, release docs, and audit results.
Canonical artifacts, manifest, Gate, runtime contracts, and trusted contributor.

confirmedFacts: WorkDependencyAnalysis owns the authoritative dependency DAG.
The approved WorkBreakdownBaseline owns the work-item universe.
WorkDependency Gate rejects cycles, missing dependencies, and impossible ordering.
Assignment, scheduling, execution, implementation status, and verification remain downstream.
Adapters cannot access or mutate TraceabilityGraph.
